> Just a quick question about clan impersonation. If this card were to be

>

> The answer is no. 1st, Lucian retains his malkavian justicarship, even
though he is not currently a malkavian. 2nd, titles and abilities are
retained despite change of clan, change of sect, whatever, so even if
Lucian became a giovanni or ravnos, he would still be malkavian justicar.
